**Finding: missing (medium severity) — TRANSITION**

The Agreement has no exit provision. Section 4 covers only renewal/notice mechanics, the Termination Date and the Termination Payment; targeted searches for transition, migration, return, export, delete/destroy turn up nothing, and Section 8 (Confidentiality) has no return-or-destroy obligation. Since HDI hosts the Site and holds our Content, user information and customer data, we would have no contractual right to get that data back or to obtain migration help on exit — short of even the fallback position.

Redline validated (ok:true): new Section 4.3 inserted after paragraph p0029, at the preferred position — up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, 30-day return of Content/user information/customer files in a machine-readable format, deletion thereafter with written certification, plus a no-withholding safeguard. The comment flags the 90-day assistance period as an acceptable fallback.
